sourceBrief: The Small Boat: replace the rejected front-facing conditioned source with a newly generated broadside paper schooner. One navy/ivory folded hull/sails faces right in photographic blue sea with warm side light. Must inspect direction, readable paper folds, connected hull and sea horizon before any moving transformation test.

images.prompt: A macro photograph of a miniature origami schooner floating in real deep blue sea. One long navy folded paper hull, two cream triangular folded paper sails. Broadside profile, bow right, stern left. Low camera; horizon behind the boat. Warm afternoon side light, creased paper fibres, realistic water, shallow optical depth.
images.negative_prompt: front view, symmetric front, real yacht, wood, canvas, duplicate vessel, extra hull, cartoon, illustration, plastic, text, watermark
